name: 配对 t 检验计算器

map.对同一对象前后/配对测量的差值进行检验。: Tests the differences from before-and-after or paired measurements on the same subjects.
map.📖 查看「配对 t 检验计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Paired t-Test Calculator User Guide"
map.差值标准差 s_d: Standard deviation of the differences s_d
map.同体前后测差异：t=d̄/(sd/√n)，df=n−1。: Pre-post differences within subjects: t=d̄/(sd/√n), df=n−1.
map.消除个体间变异、提高灵敏度。: Removes variation between subjects and increases sensitivity.
map.如用药前后血压差。: For example blood pressure before and after medication.
map.差值均值 d̄=3、差值 sd=4、n=20：t=3/(4/√20)=3/0.8: Mean difference d̄=3, sd of the differences=4, n=20: t=3/(4/√20)=3/0.894≈3.354, df=19. The critical value of ≈2.093 is exceeded, so it is significant (p<0.01) and the intervention works.
map.为何用配对而非独立 t？: Why use a paired rather than an independent t-test?
map.配对控制个体基线差异，误差更小、功效更高；前提是同一对象前后或配对设计。: Pairing controls for baseline differences between subjects, giving smaller error and higher power; it requires pre-post measurements on the same subjects or a paired design.
map.要求差值近似正态，n 大时中心极限可放宽。: The differences should be approximately normal, though with large n the central limit theorem relaxes this.
